name: rigsweep
description: Frees disk space on Windows developer PCs: drive space, a disk report, safe cache cleanup and who holds a port.
long_description: RigSweep's MCP server lets an agent see what takes disk space on a Windows developer PC (package and tool caches, old build and dependency folders, git worktrees left by agents, Docker/WSL disks) and empty only the caches that rebuild themselves. Cleaning is a dry run unless the agent passes dry_run=false. No administrator rights needed. The full RigSweep desktop app (leftover dev servers and agent CLIs, reversible tweaks) is at https://rigsweep.com.

tools.name: drive_space
tools.description: Size and free space of every drive.

tools.name: disk_report
tools.description: What takes disk space: caches, old build and dependency folders, agent worktrees, Docker/WSL disks. Read-only.

tools.name: free_disk_space
tools.description: Empty only caches that rebuild themselves. A dry run unless dry_run=false.

tools.name: port_owner
tools.description: Which processes hold a local TCP/UDP port, with PID and command line.

tools.name: report_cleanup
tools.description: Tell RigSweep which folders it handed you that you deleted. Paths only: it verifies they are gone and counts its own measured size.
